rejected.statement: Aptychodon is an extinct genus of plesiosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous in the Czech Republic.
rejected.quote: Aptychodon (meaning "unwrinkled tooth") is an extinct genus of plesiosaur from the Late Cretaceous of the Czech Republic.

rejected.statement: The teeth of Aptychodon range in length from 2.5 cm to 13 cm.
rejected.quote: They also measure between 2.5 cm and 13 cm in length.

rejected.statement: Aptychodon teeth are conical and mostly straight but curve towards one side.
rejected.quote: The teeth of Aptychodon are conical and curved towards one side despite mostly being straight.

rejected.statement: The holotype of Aptychodon consists of incompletely preserved teeth found at White Mountain near Prague, Czech Republic.
rejected.quote: The holotype consists of incompletely preserved teeth and they were discovered at White Mountain near Prague, Czech Republic.

rejected.statement: The species Aptychodon cretaceus was described by von Reuss in 1855 after the teeth were sent to the Prague Museum.
rejected.quote: They were then sent to the Prague Museum before von Reuss (1855) described the teeth and created the species Aptychodon cretaceius.

rejected.statement: Most authors classify Aptychodon in a basal position within Plesiosauria.
rejected.quote: Most authors classify Aptychodon within a basal position in Plesiosauria.

rejected.statement: Later authors have classified Aptychodon as a potential synonym of Polyptychodon interruptus.
rejected.quote: Aptychodon has been classified as a potential synonym of Polyptychodon interruptus by later authors.

rejected.statement: Aptychodon is an extinct genus of plesiosaurs from the Cretaceous found in what is now the Czech Republic.
rejected.quote: Aptychodon (que significa "dientes sin arrugas") es un género extinto de plesiosaurios pertenecientes al Cretácico encontrado en lo que hoy es República Checa.
